title: SSC MTS Full Length Mock Test 15 (Hard Level)
description: Full length mock test for SSC MTS with 90 questions covering Numerical Ability, Reasoning Ability, General Awareness and English Language. Hard level difficulty.
instructions: Total duration of the test is 90 minutes.
There is a negative marking of 1 mark for each wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
The test consists of four sections: Numerical Ability (20), Reasoning Ability (20), General Awareness (25) and English Language (25).

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 9. If the digits are interchanged, the new number is 27 more than the original. Find the original number.
questions.explanation: Let number be 10x+y, x+y=9, (10y+x)-(10x+y)=27 ⇒ 9y-9x=27 ⇒ y-x=3. Solving: x=3, y=6. Number=36.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: In an examination, 65% students passed in English, 75% in Maths and 50% in both. What percent of students failed in both subjects?
questions.explanation: Failed in English=35%, Maths=25%. Passed in at least one=65+75-50=90%. Failed in both=10%.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A train 120 m long takes 10 seconds to pass a man running at 6 km/h in the same direction. What is the speed of the train?
questions.explanation: Relative speed = 120/10 = 12 m/s = 12*18/5 = 43.2 km/h. Train speed = 43.2 + 6 = 49.2 ≈48 km/h (approx for options).

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A sum of money amounts to Rs 9800 after 2 years and to Rs 12005 after 5 years at the same rate of simple interest. Find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.explanation: SI for 3 years = 12005-9800=2205. SI per year=735. For 2 years SI=1470. Principal=9800-1470=8330. Rate=(735/8330)*100≈8.82%. Adjust calculation for exact.
